mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.3 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by >0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST and INDPRO both decline.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters where GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 0.1% over three months indicates weakening labor market momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth is < 0.1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal a contractionary monetary policy coinciding with a housing market downturn, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines and FEDFUNDS rises.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), the economy is entering a contraction phase, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where INDPRO < 100.
